# Spunkmeyers Pub & Grill

> Restaurant and pub at 993 High St, Wadsworth, OH 44281, United States. Phone: (330) 334-5080. Official website: https://spunkmeyers.pub/

## Food and drink
American pub food, smash burgers, traditional and boneless wings, pizzas, loaded fries, sandwiches, salads and entrees. 18 beers on tap. SPX American Lager is the pub's own lager, brewed in Medina, Ohio (4.7% ABV).

## Visiting
- Address: 993 High St, Wadsworth, OH 44281.
- Phone: +1-330-334-5080.
- Pub hours (America/New_York): Sunday 11am–10pm; Monday and Tuesday 4pm–midnight; Wednesday 11am–midnight; Thursday, Friday and Saturday 11am–2am the following day.
- Ask the pub about holiday hours and kitchen availability.
- Outdoor seating: the Buck Naked Bar patio.
- Sports: Cleveland Browns Backer Bar, Cleveland sports and Ohio State.
- Christmas: a seasonal Christmas pop-up with decorated rooms and lights. The homepage shows the current seasonal presentation; the Christmas website campaign ends January 1, 2027 at midnight Eastern.
- Online ordering: use the official website's DoorDash link. Delivery availability is determined at checkout.
- Group visits: submit the Events page's party request form or call. A request is not a confirmed reservation.
